title: 03. Agents from Scratch: Complete Agentic AI Curriculum — What We've Covered & What's Mis
summary: We've built a strong foundation (protocols, memory, evaluation) but the CORE reasoning patterns, advanced RAG, production ops, and safety topics are the biggest gaps.
objectives: What Do You Want to Cover Next?

sections.title: Recommended Learning Path
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                  RECOMMENDED LEARNING PATH                      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  PHASE 1: REASONING FOUNDATIONS (Week 1-2)
  ──────────────────────────────────────────
  → ReAct Pattern
  → Chain-of-Thought
  → Plan & Execute
  → Reflection & Self-Critique

  PHASE 2: ADVANCED RAG (Week 2-3)
  ──────────────────────────────────
  → CRAG (Corrective RAG)
  → Self-RAG
  → GraphRAG
  → Agentic RAG
  → Multi-Hop RAG

  PHASE 3: MULTI-AGENT SYSTEMS (Week 3-4)
  ─────────────────────────────────────────
  → Supervisor Pattern
  → AutoGen Deep Dive
  → CrewAI Deep Dive
  → Router Pattern
  → Hierarchical Agents

  PHASE 4: PRODUCTION (Week 4-5)
  ────────────────────────────────
  → Observability & Tracing
  → Cost Optimization
  → Caching Strategies
  → Safety & Guardrails
  → CI/CD for Agents

  PHASE 5: SPECIALIZED (Week 5-6)
  ─────────────────────────────────
  → Coding Agents
  → Data Analysis Agents
  → SQL Agents
  → Browser/Computer Use
  → Multi-Modal Agents
```
